defects: Domain set is written as `u '' range (n + 1)` (Finset.range, coerced to a Set of naturals) instead of gold's `u '' Iic n`; these denote the same set of indices {0,...,n} but are differently-constructed terms rather than a purely notational variant of the same structure.
`n` is implicit `{n : ℕ}` in the produced statement versus explicit `(n : ℕ)` in gold, changing the binder mode/usability though not the underlying proposition.
Arguments to `edist` are swapped (`edist (f (u (i+1))) (f (u i))` vs gold's `edist (f (u i)) (f (u (i+1)))`); mathematically equal by symmetry of edist, but not syntactically identical.
